balls.text: tries another reverse-ramp, and Sandeep beats him with a wide yorker. Willey reviews it to get a wide call but it is a fair delivery as he has moved across early
wily innovation from Willey. Slower ball, on a length, angling away, and he plays the reverse ramp. Gets enough power to clear short third
on a length, just outside off, pushed into the covers

that sounded sweet off the bat. Vyshak jumped out of the crease and swung this short-of-a-length ball into the leg side. For a moment I thought he had hit six. In actual fact, he is caught at deep midwicket
there are three men deep on the leg side, and Karthik decides to take them on. He shuffles across to drag this full and wide ball into the leg side, and manages to only toe-end it to long-on
goes for the wide yorker, misses his length, and Karthik lofts the half-volley over extra cover. Beats long-off to his left
slower bouncer, Hasaranga not awake to the bye to get Karthik on strike. Samson misses the direct hit at Karthik's end but Hasaranga is caught short on the non-striker's end. Called a wide for height
cuts a length-ball legbreak to the left of deep cover and comes back for two
punched down to long-on for another single
wide legbreak, and this time he lets it go through for the extra
full, on the pads, unable to hit it in the air. Gets a single to deep midwicket
down the wicket, Chahal goes wide, toe-ended to long-off for one
a touch short, cut away to the left of deep cover for two
stays wide, really slow, cut away, but no timing. Just the single to deep cover
slower bouncer, beats Hasaranga's attempt at the upper-cut. A valuable dot
nearly a yorker, flicked straight to deep midwicket this time

gets the yorker right, beats him too, and appeals for leg-before. Not given because he is bowling from wide on the crease, but they have reviewed it. As expected, the ball tracking confirms it is missing leg. RR have no reviews left now
not the best ball. Neither a yorker nor a hard length. Karthik just flicks it off the toes and finds the gap between long-on and deep midwicket
short, into the body, pulled to deep midwicket for one
wide on the crease, low full toss, and Hasaranga has hit it straight back to Holder
goes back to punch this legbreak to deep extra cover

another run-out. Prabhudessai looks to turn this to leg, gets a leading edge, and the ball goes towards extra cover, Prabhudessai wants one, Karthik doesn't. Prabhudessai still keeps coming, and doesn't have time to get back despite the desperate dive
legbreak, pushed through wide, Lomror gets more under it than behind it, and Padikkal takes a smart catch running in from long-off
backs away, Chahal goes wide, cut away to deep cover
legbreak, middle and leg, defended back to him
on-pace short ball, Karthik is beaten on the pull but they sneak in a leg-bye
flicked straight to short fine and Karthik calls him for one. Ashwin misses with the direct hit
nearly a yorker, pushed to long-on for another single
short of a length, on the pads, worked past short fine leg for one more
short of a length, into the body, tucked around the corner for one
short of a length, into the ribs, tucked away for one

lucky but Ashwin has deserved this luck. Maxwell nails the switch hit, but he has hit it to the tallest man on the field. Holder takes the catch at backward point. Maxwell is filthy with himself. out to the last ball of Ashwin's quota
reverse-sweep from well outside leg, gets two with it as he has placed it wide of deep cover
flat, on a length, punched down to long-on
down the wicket, and just pushes this wide of extra cover. All along the ground. Four
top edge on the cut, but it falls well short of short third
carrom ball, middle and leg, pushed to extra cover
slower bouncer, cut away to deep cover for one
misses the yorker again, hit wide of deep midwicket for two more
changes up the length. Goes on a length with the slower ball. Maxwell, though, gets some room, and crunches this square on the off side. Padikkal again saves two with w full-length dive to his left
misses the yorker again. Low full toss, and Maxwell flicks it wide of square leg. No deep square leg there. Superb placement

Jaiswal manufactures a wicket here. Misses the yorker again. Low full toss drilled just to the right of extra cover. Jaiswal hits the stumps direct, and du Plessis is caught well short. he walks back with his bat raised
misses the yorker by inches, and du Plessis clears the front leg to drill this wide of long-off
whipped to deep midwicket for one as Ashwin gives it no air
flat, short of a length, punched down to long-on
wide on the crease, into the pads, defended to leg, gets a single
carrom ball, outside off, edge on the cut, but it falls short of point

backs away early, Ashwin follows him, Maxwell gets back inside the line. Called a wide, Ashwin is not happy and rightly so. He has managed to convince Sanju Samson to review the wide. If the fast bowlers get leeway once the batter has moved to off, the spinners should too. The third umpire wants to check where the batter is when the ball is released. Maxwell has moved a long way down the leg before the release. There is nothing on the ultra edge. And they have retained the wide call. I don't think it is a fair call
on a length, middle and leg, carrom ball, pushed to deep midwicket for one
connects the reverse-sweep, but not enough power on it to get more than one
exceptional shot. Widish length ball, punched on the up, straight of the diving extra cover and wide of long-off
gets the width but punches it straight to extra cover

lovely leg glance. Around-the-wicket angle, looking to tuck batters up, but the fine leg is in the circle. Helps this length ball away, turns the bat face late, and places it fine of short fine. That's his fifty too
looks like an off-pace delivery, 123ks, Maxwell gets an inside edge on the big shot. Takes a single
short of a length, no room, cut away square, and Padikkal saves two a sensational effort at deep point. Runs to his left, and then puts in the big dive
angles it in trying to tuck him up, but overcooks it, and goes for five wides
swipes a length ball down to deep midwicket. Hundred for the stand
pushed through, into the pads, punched to deep midwicket
down thew wicket, Ashwin goes down leg, and he has to thrust his bat and leg at it. Gets a single
really slow in the air, du Plessis goes back to push this into the covers
beaten on the reverse-sweep but gets a leg-bye
big mis-hit. The carrom ball again. Maxwell wants to loft him down the ground, and the turn takes the thick outside edge. Just enough on it to clear long-on
false shot first ball as the carrom ball takes the leading edge and falls short of extra cover
no relief for the bowlers. You get Maxwell off the strike, and du Plessis then drives you over extra cover. A rare on-pace delivery from Holder, and du Plessis drives with an open face
shuffles across this time, flicks an on-pace length ball to deep midwicket
Maxwell is expecting the slower ball. Makes room early, and lofts him back over his head. Delays the down swing just for that. Brings up his fifty too
flicked away off the hips for one
another slower ball, into the pitch, and even though he cramped up, du Plessis plays the pull. And manages to place it square of deep midwicket
slower ball, sits in the pitch, defended back to him as he has no pace to work with
on a length, middle and leg, punched down to long-on for one
cut away to deep cover this time
on a length, middle and off, pushed to the left of extra cover for one
and he stays wide again, swept away to deep midwicket for one
again tries to drag a regulation sweep from well outside off. So far that it is actually called a wide
slow in the air, quite wide, Maxwell plays the regulation sweep, and places it straight of deep midwicket
slider, on a length, outside off, Maxwell tries to cut, gets a bottom edge to extra cover
wide on the crease again, on a length, into the pads, worked away to deep midwicket for one
on-pace, full and straight, flicked away to deep square leg
slower bouncer, Maxwell early into the shot, gets a leg-bye off the back of his shoulder
slower ball, short of a length, tucked away to leg for one
wide on the crease, fullish and straight, pushed to the right of deep midwicket but can't come back for two
on a length, angling in, turned away to deep square leg for one
driven straight to extra cover. A touch wide, but he has found the fielder
slider, wicket to wicket, defended
that's a Maxwell special. Deep cover is quite straight so he goes down on a knee and reverses his stance to reverse-sweep it over point
cuts away a length ball, to the left of deep cover
slider, into the pads, doesn't get enough bat on it to be able to beat short fine
legbreak, middle and leg, pushed to the right of point for one
offbreak, turning into the pads, punched down to deep midwicket
superb shot. Picks the carrom ball, makes room, and lofts this length ball clean over mid-off for six
pushed straight to cover
thick inside edge. He is looking for a big bad slog, but the ball dips and turns. The inside edge, though, travels between square leg and short fine
big sweep first ball, looking to go square, beaten, but it is pitched outside leg
on a length, flat, pushed down to long-on for one
tight single as he hits to midwicket and runs. He is quick to get across
length ball, on the pads, pushed wide of mid-on for one
great manipulation of the field. This time he scythes a length ball to the right of short third. Times it so well despite an open face
short of a length, angling in, worked wide of mid-on for one
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep point
delicate touch now. Boult goes short of a length, not much room, but third is inside the circle, and he just guides it finer of that man
this is a superb counterattack. Only just short of a length, and he plays the pick-up pull over midwicket
makes room again, but this time he hits it back to Sandeep
an even better shot. This is on a good length. Possibly short of it. Du Plessis gives himself room, and lofts him straight back over his head
first six of the match. Just overpitches a little when compared to the last two balls. Du Plessis clears the front leg, and lofts him inside-out over mid-off
wicket to wicket, on a good length, and short midwicket is in the play again
on a length, straight, holds its line, defended to leg
pulls the length back a little, Maxwell steers this to the right of deep third for two
overpitched and wide outside off, Maxwell repeats the drive with the open face to find the gap between point and cover
inswinging yorker, Maxwell does well to take his toes out of the way and get the bat down in time
flicks a straight ball but there is a short square leg in place just for this. Has done well to keep this down
easy as. Two wickets down, no problem. Just a push-drive to a length ball, between point and cover for four

wicket with the first ball of the second over too. The shot is on, really. Short ball, angling in, midwicket off the 30-yard ring. All he has to do is pull over him, but ends up hitting it straight to Jaiswal stationed there
wide length ball, driven on the up, but there is a sweeper on the off side to keep this down to one
wicket to wicket now, pushed down to long-on for one
gets a bit of width, and du Plessis plays a cover-drive straighter than the last one. Beats the man at short cover to his right, and mid-off to his left
cover-drive from around off, but can't beat the man at short cover
first boundary of the match. Du Plessis waits for this length ball, and lofts it over mid-on. This might have been the inswinger
swinging in, pushed to mid-on
swinging in, du Plessis stays beside the line of it, and pushes it wide of cover for one
swinging in, pushed back to Boult
pushed to cover, big shout of no
nearly a second wicket. Looks to push this towards mid-on, gets a leading edge, but it falls short of mid-off. Just clears the short cover, and falls just short of mid-off
on a length, shaping away, pushed to short cover

why do we even bother asking Boult if he will pick a first-over wicket? He has snapped one first ball. Full, swinging in, on the target, past his inside edge. No discussion even for a review. Kohli walks off. Plumb as
Short and wide, he cuts it straight to backward point. Virat Kohli pumps his fists as RCB collect the two points!
Slower ball outside off, he can only pull it out to deep midwicket and the Chinnaswamy roars with the win all but sealed!
Picks out deep midwicket now! It's full outside off, Ashwin looks to swing it leg-side but doesn't hit it well enough. Prabhudessai makes no mistake and now it's 9 off 2 with Jurel off strike!
And why shouldn't Ashwin keep strike?! Full on leg and he swings it behind square and Siraj can't cut it out in the deep!

Harshal nails the yorker and Ashwin digs it out through midwicket. Harshal chases after it and throws it. Willey can't collect and then tries to kick the ball onto the stumps but misses. Ashwin keeps strike

Oh that's gone for four! What's happened there?! It's a slower ball outside off, Ashwin is looking to pull and checks his shot in the last moment. But the top edge takes it over the keeper and the ball runs away! Royals will take that any day of the week!

Is that another run-out? Jurel works it out to long-on and Lomror throws it to Siraj, who takes the stumps off. But Siraj is not happy with the throw and has some words for Lomror. It was quite wide and Siraj's leg hit the stumps taking off one bail. The ball also came out of his hands as he tried to hit the stumps. Yup, the ball was out of his hands and Ashwin survives. More importantly for Royals, they have the extra run
There's a six Royals were waiting for! It's full on off, Jurel has moved across and he just whips it off his toes over square leg. It's in the gap and crosses the rope
Short and wide and he can only swing it away to deep midwicket
On a length on leg, Jurel can only pull it away to deep square leg
On a length on off, he pulls it unconvincingly to deep midwicket. Ashwin just about makes it back at the non-striker's as they race for two
Bangs it in short, Ashwin miscues the pull to midwicket and it's just a single, but Jurel is now on strike

Nice relay fielding in the deep helps RCB save a boundary! Drives a full delivery down the ground. Maxwell from long-off runs to his right and pushes it out to Kohli, who was running to his left from long-on

Direct hit! Prabhudessai had one stump to aim at from cover and he nails the throw at the non-striker's! Hetmyer never even stopped running as he knew he was short by a mile. He hit it to cover and ran off a length ball and Prabhudessai's brilliant throw means he is back in the dugout
Almost nails the wide yorker but Jurel reaches out and hits it out to long-off
Hetmyer is beaten all ends up with a back of good length delivery on leg and it goes towards backward square off his pads. They run the leg-bye
Full just outside off, he swings it down the ground on the bounce to long-on

Banged in short on leg, he looks to ramp it but can't connect. Willey took the pace off. Jurel thinks that was above head-height. He has reviewed it. This looks close. And the third umpire decides it was above the head. It's called a wide. Some confusion too as the third umpire thought it was the second bouncer of the over so he wanted it to be no-ball, but after clarification stuck with the wide call
And Jurel has rocked that ball for a six! It's full on leg and he just flicks it away behind square and it goes all the way!
Short outside off, he pulls it to deep square leg
Full on middle and Jurel gets some bat on it as it trickles away very fine down the leg side for the second boundary of the over
Bangs it in short on leg, Hetmyer looks to swing it away but is hit on the back. The ball goes towards backward point as the fielders pick up a leg bye
On a length outside off, he taps it to backward point for a single
Full on off, Hetmyer drives it out to long-off
Full and wide, and it's called wide again! Kohli checks with Karthik if that's worth reviewing but he says no
Full and fired down leg. The batters pick up a bye as well
Bisects deep square leg and deep midwicket with a pull off the short ball. Much needed boundary for Rajasthan Royals
Back of a length on middle, but it's fired down leg
Bangs it in short outside off, Jurel pulls it to deep square leg
Short and wide, Jurel steers it fine on the off side but it's straight to backward point
Full toss outside off and Hetmyer scuppers it to long-off off a couple of bounces

Full on off, he gets it off the inside half of the bat as he chips it down the ground. But it lands well short of Kohli at long-on. Kohli almost overran the ball but he adjusts in time to stop the boundary
Fires it down leg and Karthik dives and does really well to stop that from racing away for four

Hit straight to short third this time! Harshal is pumped and as he should be! It's sort and wide, angling in and Samson cuts hard. It flies to Shahbaz who takes it reverse-cupped in front of his face. An inch on either side of the fielder, that was four more, but instead Harshal has his second wicket of the day
Oh that's nicely put away! Dipping wide yorker and Samson steers it past backward point. Harshal did little wrong there, but Samson is in too good a touch!
Googly on middle, Hetmyer plays it back to the bowler
That was almost a bouncer from Hasaranga! It's a wrong'un outside off. Pitches on the rough and almost takes Samson's head off! He backs away and it beats Karthik too as the batters take a bye
Pulled away and it goes all the way! It's on a length on middle and he rocks back and boshes it over midwicket
On a length outside off, Hetmyer punches it out to wide long-off
Drops it short outside off, he goes back and punches to the right of the cover fielder
Gets it away this time, though! Gets hold of the full delivery outside off and smacks him down the ground
Back of a length outside off, he chops it to cover
On a length on middle, Jaiswal blocks to short cover

Jaiswal has picked out Virat Kohli in the deep! It's a dipping full toss on off and he has a swing. Kohli gets his 101st IPL catch as he reverse-cups it as the pressure tells on the Royals! Kohli blows a kiss to the crowd, who lap it up of course
Full on middle and off, he swings it away to the left of deep midwicket. Royals only get one run thanks to some sharp fielding
Full toss, Jaiswal looks for a reverse sweeps and misses. Jaiswal falls, but Dinesh Karthik misses his throw at the striker's end and it lets them run the leg-bye
On a length on off, he clips it through midwicket. Jaiswal wanted a second, but Samson sends him back
Tossed up full outside off, Samson eases it through covers to the fielder in the deep
A misfield by Vyshak at backward point almost costs RCB a boundary but Prabhudessai ensures it's only a couple of runs for the Royals with a dive in the deep
On a length on leg, Jaiswal sweeps to deep backward square
Full on leg, he clips it to backward square and gets the single
Tossed up slower in the air outside off, Samson defends towards cover
On a length outside off, Samson can only glove it down behind him
On a length on middle, Samson steers it to deep point to get off the mark
Length ball on leg, Samson defends it in front of off with the ball going across him
Straight to long-on! Willey with the breakthrough. It's back of a length on off, Padikkal comes down and looks to swing it away but doesn't get a hold of it. Easy pickings for Virat Kohli
Full on leg, he makes room and looks to whip it away but finds the fielder in the deep
On a length on off, he hangs back and whips it to deep midwicket this time
Short of good length just outside off and it jags in and cuts Padikkal in half as he looks to cut
Drags it down on leg, Padikkal rocks back and pulls it behind square but the fielder in the deep keeps it out. First boundary-less over since the first over!
Tossed up full on leg, Padikkal whips it away to long-on and brings up a 30-ball fifty
Drops it short on off, Padikkal backs away and cuts it straight to cover
Tossed up full outside off, Jaiswal sweeps it hard but straight to deep midwicket
Googly on leg, he whips it away to deep midwicket
Goes for the wide yorker and manages to finish with a dot ball. Jaiswal reached out for it but couldn't connect
Full on off, Jaiswal eases it to cover and sneaks a quick single
Short and wide and this time it's cut to deep point
Slapped away through covers now! It's back of length again and going across him this time. Padikkal clears his front leg and puts it away through
Swung away behind square for four more. It's a back-of-length slower ball on leg and Padikkal swivels and rolls his wrists and just beats the fielder in the deep running to his left
Bangs it in short outside leg and it goes over his head. Called a wide
Full on off, Jaiswal drives it out to long-off

Just past the fielder and he gets four! It's on a length on off, a wrong'un again. Padikkal waits and pulls this hard to Shahbaz Ahmed's left at deep midwicket. Shahbaz ran and dived but it was just beyond him
Dropped short around off and he pulls it to deep midwicket
Another googly on leg that ends up on off. He clips it out through midwicket again
On a length on middle and off, it's a googly, and he reads it well and clips it away to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, he rocks back and cuts to sweeper cover
It's on a length on off, and Padikkal just dabs it past the wicketkeeper. He gets two as the short third fielder chases it down
Streaky, but he will take it! it's fired down leg and he goes for the sweep. Doesn't quite connect but it trickles away fine
Full outside off, he drives it out to long-off
On a length on middle, Padikkal clips it away aerially through midwicket. Maxwell gives chase to retrieve it
Speared in full on middle and leg, he goes to defend and the ball rolls towards backward point. They sneak the single
Full on leg, he turns it to deep midwicket
That's hit hard! Skips out to a full delivery and thrashes it flat over extra cover
Slower ball, short of good length outside leg. Jaiswal gets leg-side of it still and cuts it away to the fielder in the deep
Bangs it in short at 129kph, Jaiswal sways away. Looked to ramp it late, but can't connect
Full on leg, and he drives it out to long-off
On a length outside leg, Jaiswal pulls it to deep backward square
On a length on middle, he nudges it out todeep midwicket
Sweetly hit over long-off. It's full on off, with pace off, and Padikkal leans into it and swings it down the ground. The bottom hand came off in the follow-through, but it didn't matter
On a length outside off, he cuts it straight to backward point
Miscues the pull to a short delivery but it falls short of mid-on
That is huuuuuuge! Skips out to a full delivery and goes downtown! Long-on would not have had a chance even if there was one
Fuller on off and he drives it straight to cover
Oh lovely placement! Speared n full on middle and Padikkal rolls his wrists and beats mid-on to his left. The fielder gives chase, but that was always running away
Back of a length on leg and Padikkal tucks it behind to deep backward square
Full on off, Padikkal eases it to cover
Full outside off and Padikkal steers it behind point again. And it beats both backward point and short third!
Swing and a miss now! It's another back of length delivery and he has a swish at it but the ball goes over the bat
Back of a length and wide and Padikkal gets low and steers this to backward point's right, just beating the fielder
And he is welcomed with some disdain by Padikkal! It's full outside off and Padikkal backs away to make room and drives it through cover
On a length outside off and Padikkal goes back and punches it to sweeper cover's left
Full on middle and off, Padikkal clips it to mid-on
Fuller on off, Jaiswal drives it down the ground and gets the single to mid-on
On a length outside off, Jaiswal looks to cut and misses. That was at 131kph
Slapped over point! Short and wide and he skips down and hits it square on the off side
On a length outside off, Padikkal goes back and punches this through cover
Full on middle, Jaiswal drives it but can't beat mid-off. Siraj closes off the over well after going for boundaries off the first two balls
Back of a length on leg and finishing on off, Padikkal punches it behind point and gets off the mark
Leg-stump bumper and Padikkal moves his head out of the way
Full around off again, Jaiswal this time picks out deep backward point with the drive
It's full this time, but Jaiswal leans in and drives it square and through the gap between point and backward point. Back-to-back boundaries
Hits him back over his head! It's short on leg and going across, Jaiswal waits and swings it down the ground for a one-bounce four
Back of a length around off and Jaiswal goes on the back foot to punch it to deep point
Full on off, Jaiswal defends to the on side
Beats him on the drive! it's full outside off, Jaiswal looks to go through covers but the ball zips past the outside edge
Full on middle, Jaiswal whips it away to midwicket
And there's the first boundary for the Royals. It's a back of length delivery with width on offer and Jaiswal cuts it through short third where there's no fielder
Jaiswal steps out and drives this straight to the cover fielder. Kohli spills it, but they don't risk the single
Back of a length on leg, Padikkal stays in line and defends
Starts off by leaving a full delivery outside off

Ohhhh he has gone through him with a beauty! Buttler goes for a duck in the first over! Wobble-seam delivery on a length outside off and it seams in and goes through the gap as Buttler pushed away from his body
On a length outside off, Buttler taps it down towards cover point
Full outside off and Jaiswal slashes at it. Falls just short of deep third where Harshal Patel does well to prevent the boundary
Starts with a length ball on leg, it's tucked straight to midwicket
